text:
margo (product): quick thread to align on the 'Azimuth' initiative: customer-driven private pilot (KMS/HSM) + strict p95 SLOs. Need a compact launch checklist, owners, and sequencing. Call out hidden blockers.

diego (eng-runtime): major work: prewarm prefix cache, runtime flag gating, and a tiny API to surface warm/hit headers. Estimate: flag + metrics = 2 wks, bench harness + e2e = 1 wk. blocker: prewarm affects scheduler hot path; need infra isolation.

yen (eng-infra): isolation plan: reserve a small Dedicated pool (5 GPUs) with label azimuth-pilot=true. Will require finance signoff; ETA 4 business days after. Also need autoscaler exclusion for that pool.

noor (security): security items: KMS smoke test, HSM attestation (for on-prem), key-rotation runbook, and audit-event schema for fallback. Compliance tenants must have fallback disabled.

cass (prod-ops): propose minimal launch criteria: 1) infra reserved and labeled, 2) KMS path verified, 3) bench: steady p95 <= 140ms for <=512 tokens, cold-start <=420ms, 4) audit + rotation runbook in repo.

amy (customer-success): customers ask for transparent fallback behavior and a dashboard hook for fallback events (reason + timestamp). Also want an opt-in for hosted fallback.

diego (eng-runtime): agree with criteria. I'll add telemetry tags: azimuth.prefix_hit=true/false and header x-azimuth-warmness. I'll split into 3 tickets: FLAG, METRICS, BENCH by EOD tomorrow.

yen (eng-infra): opening INF-5501 to request reservation; adding rack-persistence and node pool exclusion. pinging @cass for cost approval.

noor (security): drafting SEC-3310 checklist; will include audit schema and a short compromised-key rotation runbook. Can sign off after KMS smoke test in a reserved env.

cass (prod-ops): ops notes: pilot week needs on-call rotation and an alert for fallback-rate > 0.5% or p95 regression > 15%. Rollback criteria: fallback >1% sustained for 30m or billing egress spike.

deploy-bot: feature-flag created: azimuth_prewarm_v1 (disabled). Canary window will run when @diego marks bench:green and @noor marks security:approved.

margo (product): thanks. I'll compile sequencing storyboard: A) infra+billing+security artifacts, B) runtime flags+metrics+bench, C) 3-customer canary + acceptance. Go/no-go after B. Optional sync at 10am tomorrow.

diego (eng-runtime): small config snippet for bench:
```
prewarm: { enabled: true, reserved_threads: 16, capacity: { sustained_qps: 40, burst_qps: 80 } }
```
will attach initial bench results when ready.

yen (eng-infra): INF-5501 opened. cass, can you confirm budget?

cass (prod-ops): confirming budget now, will update INF-5501. I'll also schedule on-call rota for pilot week.

margo (product): perfect. if you see unexpected scope creep (e.g., additional API surface for warmness), flag here. I'll post final storyboard + pilot dates later today.
